# Keep draft recovery notices consistent across open windows

## What & Why
Users can open EscapeHatch in more than one browser window, but an unsaved draft notice currently lives in one page's in-memory state. Keeping recovery notices and deadlines consistent across open windows would prevent one window from offering recovery after another window has already discarded or expired it.

## Done looks like
- Draft recovery state is coordinated across open EscapeHatch windows without overwriting the draft contents unexpectedly.
- A notice removed or expired in one window is not offered as recoverable in another window.
- Answer and opportunity drafts follow the same coordination rules.
